name: Andaz Xintiandi
insider_take: This sleek boutique hotel seamlessly blends contemporary design with Shanghai's rich cultural heritage in the heart of the city's most fashionable district.
whats_special: Located in the historic Xintiandi entertainment district, the hotel occupies a prime spot where traditional Shikumen architecture meets modern luxury. The property features locally-inspired artwork and design elements that pay homage to Shanghai's 1930s golden era, while the rooftop bar offers stunning views of the city's glittering skyline.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing north for the best views of People's Square and the Bund's iconic skyline, especially magical at sunset.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature restaurant serves innovative Shanghainese cuisine, and you're just steps away from Xintiandi's cobblestone lanes filled with boutique shopping, art galleries, and some of Shanghai's most acclaimed restaurants. The nearby Shikumen Museum offers fascinating insights into traditional Shanghai architecture and lifestyle.
pros: Prime location in historic Xintiandi entertainment district
Contemporary design blending local Shanghai culture with modern luxury
Exceptional dining venues featuring local and international cuisine
Hyatt Prive benefits including exclusive perks and personalized service
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and prime location
Urban setting may experience city noise and bustling atmosphere
